LanguageData.Proj_GrenadeType99K.label: Type 99(Kai) Frag Grenade
LanguageData.PaWT_GrenadeType99K.label: Type 99(Kai) Frag Grenade
LanguageData.PaWT_GrenadeType99K.description: Modified version of Type 99 "Kiska" Hand Grenade, with pineapple fragmentation coat like the Type 97 and Type 91 Frag Grenade to improve its Anti-personnel capability, overall performance is still weaker than average fragmentation grenade with the reduced size and explosion charge, but is very light and small to carry around.
LanguageData.PaWT_GrenadeType99K.verbs.0.label: throw Type 99(Kai) frag grenade
LanguageData.PaWT_Trap_Type99K.label: Type 99(Kai) Booby Trap
LanguageData.PaWT_Trap_Type99K.description: A very simple booby trap made with this type of grenade, simple, lethal and very cheap, require target step on it to trigger the delay fuse.
